name: homestro_product_search
description: Search the Homestro Shopify catalog and return products with title, status, price, category, tags, variants, images, SEO and collections.

name: homestro_read_variants
description: Read one Homestro product including every variant, selected option values, SKUs and assigned images before changing anything.

name: homestro_price_check
description: Check Homestro economics: supplier cost <= 12 EUR and selling price >= 3x supplier cost. No fixed minimum selling price.

name: homestro_create_draft
description: Create a German Shopify product draft. Always DRAFT; never publishes.

name: homestro_optimize_product
description: Optimize an existing Homestro product while keeping it DRAFT. Read variants first, preserve images, and verify mutations.

inputSchema.name: homestro_next_railway_task
inputSchema.description: Railway is the Homestro brain. Get the next queued Railway instruction for Sidekick to execute in Shopify. Do not invent a task when none is returned.

inputSchema.name: homestro_submit_railway_task_result
inputSchema.description: Report the result of a Railway task after executing it in Shopify.

inputSchema.name: homestro_railway_task_status
inputSchema.description: Read Railway task queue status: queued, leased and completed tasks.

inputSchema.name: homestro_catalog_autopilot_run
inputSchema.description: Start the Homestro Railway catalog processor.

inputSchema.name: homestro_catalog_autopilot_status
inputSchema.description: Read the live Homestro Railway autopilot status.
